messages:
Eli: Kicking off onboarding for Harbor Health (trial). Goal: search integration + 30-day pilot so we can surface a renewal recommendation. Posting owners and a short timeline. Keep updates brief here.

Sam: I can take SSO (SAML metadata + cert). Will request metadata today. If no reply in 48h I'll escalate. :thumbsup:

Rowan: I'll own ingestion and schema mapping. Need two sample exports and a field spec. @Eli can you confirm where those land?

Tess: Enablement lead here. Proposing a 40-min workshop Day 4: overview, integration checklist, runbook, Q&A. Who from Harbor should join?

Eli: Sending sample exports to Rowan now: https://files.redwood.internal/harbor/samples. Request Harbor to invite PM + infra to workshop.

Sam: SSO fallback plan: if cert takes >7 days we run short-term API-key tokens for staging tests. Eng-security may need to reformat cert chain if vendor uses nonstandard PEM.

Rowan: Note on schema gaps: if they omit relevance weight field we'll create a mapping shim but that adds ~3 dev-days. Marking as Medium risk.

Tess: Draft enablement agenda: 1) Objectives & success criteria 2) Data flow demo 3) Ops/alerts + rollback 4) Q&A. Will post slides by EOD Tue.

Eli: Compact timeline/code block: 
```
Day 0: Account access + initial creds (owner: Eli)
Day 1-4: Export delivery + schema mapping (owner: Rowan)
Day 4: Enablement workshop (owner: Tess)
Day 5-12: SSO validation & smoke tests (owner: Sam)
Day 7-16: Canary + perf baseline (owner: Rowan/Sam)
Day 14: NPS pulse & quality check (owner: Eli)
Day 21-30: Go/No-go & renewal signal (owner: Eli)
```

Sam: Quota suggestion for trial: start 12 RPS, 1.5M tokens/day, allow burst to 25 RPS for initial smoke. Will tune after baseline.

Rowan: Success criteria suggestion: "Activation = >=100 prod queries/day AND 90th_pct_latency <650ms by Day30". Also track query CTR and returned relevance score distribution.

Eli: Escalation rules: Day3 blocking -> @Eli + tag Solutions Eng. Day7 critical blocker -> Director CS + Eng oncall. If SSO >10d or schema unresolved >14d -> label High renewal risk and prepare exec summary.

security-bot: Note: Eng-security may need to review SAML cert. Raised ticket #SEC-8942.

Tess: Calendar: I'll send invites for Day4 workshop and a recurring 30-min weekly sync (Weds 9:30 PT). Please accept.

calendar-bot: Event created: "Harbor Health - Onboarding Weekly" Wednesdays 09:30-10:00 PT 1 attendees invited: Eli, Sam, Rowan, Tess, Harbor PM.

Eli: Thanks team. I'll update the shared tracker and tag owners. Quick updates only in-thread; escalate blockers as noted. :rocket:
